notes.title: Theatre of War 3: Korea is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and Theatre of War 3: Korea is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

notes.title: Men of War II Announced - New WWII RTS game coming 2022!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6Y1zhLnZyO4;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings Commanders! We are happy to announce Men of War II, the anticipated sequel to the acclaimed RTS franchise published by 1C Entertainment and developed by Best Way studio!

Experience World War II like never before! Men of War II will bring all-new units, locations, campaigns and game modes, combined with the series’ trademark historical accuracy and action-filled gameplay on Eastern and Western Fronts of WWII. Stay tuned to experience the unforgiving heat of WW II battles first hand.

Wishlist MEN OF WAR II on Steam right now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/

notes.title: New Release - Theatre of War 3: Korea
notes.content:
Theatre of War 3: Korea is now available on Steam!

Replay the events of the first hot war of the Cold War era, the Korean War! Test your strategic skills by managing reserves, fuel and ammo supplies as you move your forces over the entire Korean Peninsula.
